name: Shenzhen KTC Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen KTC Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sale, and service of audio-visual and related products in China. It offers TV, frame and floating TV, and single-sided screen; commercial display products, such as interactive flat panel, signage monitor, professional display equipment, LCD video wall, and digital signage; medical display, including solutions and modules; and smart mirror products.
